crossrefs.text: “For My people are fools; they have not known Me. They are foolish children, without understanding. They are skilled in doing evil, but they know not how to do good.”

“I will sweep away man and beast; I will sweep away the birds of the air, and the fish of the sea, and the idols with their wicked worshipers. I will cut off mankind from the face of the earth,” declares the LORD.
The earth mourns and withers; the world languishes and fades; the exalted of the earth waste away.
The city is left in ruins; its gate is reduced to rubble.
Like raiders who lie in ambush, so does a band of priests; they murder on the way to Shechem; surely they have committed atrocities.
Hear, O mountains, the LORDʼs indictment, you enduring foundations of the earth. For the LORD has a case against His people, and He will argue it against Israel:
He rebukes the sea and dries it up; He makes all the rivers run dry. Bashan and Carmel wither, and the flower of Lebanon wilts.
Micaiah continued, “Therefore hear the word of the LORD: I saw the LORD sitting on His throne, and all the host of heaven standing by Him on His right and on His left.
Therefore My people will go into exile for their lack of understanding; their dignitaries are starving and their masses are parched with thirst.
Even zeal is no good without knowledge, and he who hurries his footsteps misses the mark.
For I desire mercy, not sacrifice, and the knowledge of God rather than burnt offerings.
And even if our gospel is veiled, it is veiled to those who are perishing.
For God, who said, “Let light shine out of darkness,” made His light shine in our hearts to give us the light of the knowledge of the glory of God in the face of Jesus Christ.
Hear the word of the LORD, O children of Israel, for the LORD has a case against the people of the land: “There is no truth, no loving devotion, and no knowledge of God in the land!
‘These people honor Me with their lips, but their hearts are far from Me.
They accepted none of my counsel; they despised all my reproof.
Wine is a mocker, strong drink is a brawler, and whoever is led astray by them is not wise.
Surely you will be ashamed of the sacred oaks in which you have delighted; you will be embarrassed by the gardens that you have chosen.

These also stagger from wine and stumble from strong drink: Priests and prophets reel from strong drink and are befuddled by wine. They stumble because of strong drink, muddled in their visions and stumbling in their judgments.
say to a tree, ‘You are my father,’ and to a stone, ‘You gave me birth.’ They have turned their backs to Me and not their faces. Yet in the time of trouble they say, ‘Rise up and save us!’
Their deeds do not permit them to return to their God, for a spirit of prostitution is within them, and they do not know the LORD.
But watch yourselves, or your hearts will be weighed down by dissipation, drunkenness, and the worries of life—and that day will spring upon you suddenly like a snare.
They must no longer offer their sacrifices to the goat demons to which they have prostituted themselves. This will be a permanent statute for them for the generations to come.’
then I will set My face against that man and his family and cut off from among their people both him and all who follow him in prostituting themselves with Molech.
So I gave them up to their stubborn hearts to follow their own devices.
All their evil appears at Gilgal, for there I hated them. I will drive them from My house for the wickedness of their deeds. I will no longer love them; all their leaders are rebellious.
Is there iniquity in Gilead? They will surely come to nothing. Do they sacrifice bulls in Gilgal? Indeed, their altars will be heaps of stones in the furrows of the field.
Do not accept a bribe, for a bribe blinds those who see and twists the words of the righteous.
But I will scatter you among the nations and will draw out a sword after you as your land becomes desolate and your cities are laid waste.
Do not deny justice or show partiality. Do not accept a bribe, for a bribe blinds the eyes of the wise and twists the words of the righteous.
But their vine is from the vine of Sodom and from the fields of Gomorrah. Their grapes are poisonous; their clusters are bitter. Their wine is the venom of serpents, the deadly poison of cobras.
But his sons did not walk in his ways; they turned aside toward dishonest gain, accepting bribes and perverting justice.
